bound_definition: Observed lower growth = minimum post PSS minus maximum baseline PSS; observed upper growth = maximum post PSS minus minimum baseline PSS. Raw signed growth values are never clamped. Ratio denominator alone has the declared 1 MiB noise floor.
scope: Same process, successful complete ordinary ten-city forecasts, unchanged bundled icons. No nativehook in these trials. This measures warmed process-PSS growth, not total live malloc blocks or open file descriptors.
